description: A GET route reads a review by id using the service-role client, with no session or ownership check anywhere in the function.

required_findings.exploit_preconditions: None — any caller (authenticated or not) who can guess or obtain a review id can read it, because the service-role client bypasses RLS and no ownership/membership check exists in this function.

explanation: This is the spec's own §9 'Example A' scenario, as a standalone fixture: createServiceSupabaseClient() bypasses RLS entirely, and the route never checks the caller's session or workspace membership before returning the row. Correct remediation (per the spec's safe pattern) is the user-session client (RLS-scoped) or an explicit membership check before the service-role read.
